entry.title: Development :: RE: [AI] Someone ran my homebrew through an LLM
entry.dc:creator: toxa
entry.dc:subject: Development
entry.content:
Author: toxa
Posted: Mon Nov 16, 2026 10:03 pm (GMT 0)

i mean accepting or rejecting pull requests is a good will of the repo maintainer. especially of a free opensource project. reasons for reject may be whatever from lack of time to the personal dislike.

there are a lot of strange guys on the internet

some people fix one letter typo in the depth of the readme to become the contributor of the popular repo

others are searching for the opensource repos which they think violate some licenses to which they have no relation of course

and so on and so forth. now this AI hype...

i don't think there is a way to forbid feeding opensource repos to LLMs, especially the old ones with permissive licenses. if you can't stop that, better keep your nerves safe.
